styleGuide: Use casual, friendly Japanese (だ/である調ではなく、ですます調またはくだけた調を場面に応じて使い分ける)
Keep sentence endings consistent with speaker's enthusiastic tone (e.g., 〜ね、〜よ、〜んだ)
Translate 'you' as あなた or omit; use みなさん for audience address
For photography terms, use common Japanese equivalents (e.g., 撮影, 編集, 光)
Keep proper nouns in original script (e.g., Paris, Instagram, Sonilo)
Use natural contractions and colloquialisms where appropriate (e.g., すごく, ちょっと)
Avoid overly literal translations; prioritize natural flow in Japanese
